text: Endothelial dysfunction is critical in the pathogenesis of acute kidney injury (AKI). It sought to investigate the role of endothelial activation and stress index (EASIX) in risk stratification and treatment optimization for critically ill patients with AKI.
source_label: Endothelial activation and stress index in risk stratification and treatment optimization for critically ill patients with acute kidney injury: A retrospective cohort study from MIMIC-Ⅳ database
